propositions: New plan reviews must sign deterministic manifest pins for all direct children and direct prerequisites, binding each related ticket's canonical ID, role, and current narrow material fingerprint.

When enforcement is enabled, material drift in a pinned prerequisite or child invalidates the downstream attestation; propagation is deliberate and local—only direct dependents are affected by their immediate upstream changes.
Ticket review phase transitions automatically between planning and execution based on status events: open/idea→planning, entry into in_progress→execution, re-entering open→planning reset.
Execution-phase reviews require a numeric priority-floor of at least 0.80; blocking-threshold resolution applies max(criterion-threshold, 0.80) except for prerequisite-consistency which retains 0.60.
The close gate, when both enforcement flags are enabled, blocks on any pin drift or incompatible review phase; code freshness changes alone do not invalidate the review.

Prerequisite consistency evaluation is deterministic and specialized: each readable prerequisite receives exactly one coverage record with disposition consistent|finding|indeterminate; any indeterminate record makes the overall review unsigned.
